structured_output.analysis: The only measured grid is iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). It has almost no spare room under the bit budget, so any upgrade has to be paid for. All 4 proposals last round were refused only because their rationales quoted a rounded KL value. This round's rationales use only values exactly as they appear in the ledger. The biggest single-layer losses are int3/int2 MLP projections, and int4 roughly halves or better their single-layer KL. None of the retrieved layers is a cheap downgrade candidate. So the upgrades are paid for by raising group_size to 256 on rht_gptq_int3, its most common method, which halves the per-group scale overhead. I also test act_order on its own, since it costs no bits, and combined with the funded upgrades.

proposals.name: opt_act_order_all
proposals.rationale: This changes no bits and only sets act_order=true for every GPTQ variant. It targets the dominant GPTQ int3/int2 losses: for example, model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj with gptq_int3 has a single-layer KL of 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded], and model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 has 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065]. The measured base is E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: g256_rht3_fund_mlp_int4
proposals.rationale: Setting group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 halves its scale overhead, and the saved bits pay for 4 MLP upgrades to int4. Measured single-layer KL for each upgrade: layer 3 up_proj, rht_gptq_int3 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5] vs gptq_int4 0.00237732 [Ef4ee8cb4969e]; layer 1 up_proj, rht_gptq_int3 0.00611131 [E0564bc6ad1eb] vs rht_gptq_int4 0.00227173 [E779bc065b72e]; layer 27 gate_proj, rht_gptq_int3 0.00498703 [Efa0bb391da67] vs rht_gptq_int4 0.00153131 [Ef428ac081334]; layer 27 up_proj, gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded] vs gptq_int4 0.00216589 [Efea8c18d2abc]. The measured base is E514ab09c524e.

proposals.name: g256_rht3_fund_mlp_int4_actorder
proposals.rationale: This uses the same funded upgrades as g256_rht3_fund_mlp_int4 and adds act_order=true, which may offset the extra error from the larger group_size=256 groups. Measured single-layer KL: layer 3 up_proj, rht_gptq_int3 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5] vs gptq_int4 0.00237732 [Ef4ee8cb4969e]; layer 27 gate_proj, rht_gptq_int3 0.00498703 [Efa0bb391da67] vs rht_gptq_int4 0.00153131 [Ef428ac081334]. The measured base is E514ab09c524e.
